_note: Reviewer scores every criterion 0-10; the script computes the weighted total. Weights sum to 1.

criteria.what: silhouette, proportions, rounded edges (no sharp edges), parts sit correctly (no intersections/floating)
two paint colours (pale front door, darker sides/back), value and saturation like the concept, door seam
glowing display: cool white glow, two shelves, 6 bottles each with caps and colours, light raised frame with worn edge
info panel, button/coin panel, pickup flap, small vent: shapes, depth, crisp openings, materials
chip amount/size distribution per zone and side (description table), ragged flakes with rim, no blobs/peas/stamps, large flakes on back and sides
worn edges first: roof rounding, vertical edges, frames, button housings; broken primer strips, metal core
rust drip clusters only from real sources (panel, buttons, flap, vents, frame bottom), wide stain + strands, bell lengths 3-10 cm, irregular
olive grime/mould only in the bottom 5-10 cm and on the feet; nowhere else
consistency with the scene style rules (scene_style.md): would it sit next to the post box from the same scene
